notes.title: Update 1.0.6 is live!
notes.notes:
Update 1.0.6 is now live! 

Patch notes:
• New Ghoul variant
• New loading screen hint (enemy kill info)
• New SFX: item throw, Zarutz shoot, Jake air attack, bounce, werewolf howl
• New mutator: customize enemy count!
• Pre-boss cooldowns = better prep time
• Difficulty tuning + portrait fixes (Level 3)
• Jake: improved unlockable colors
• New unlockable colors for all characters 🎨
• No more blood VFX on certain enemies (as in OG)
• Fixed: double hit SFX bug, Ghostcopter shaking, Jake's desperation move height
 + Tons of other fixes & tweaks!

Thank you for your ongoing feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 for Night Slashers: Remake is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862530/898d4534880fc159cdeed176950554a2b18d6b20.jpg[/img]

Patch 1.0.5 for Night Slashers: Remake is now live!

The latest update includes:

Adjustments:
[list]
[*] Liu Feilin's special attack: Adjusted activation conditions and increased cooldown.
[*] Hong Hua's desperation attack: Removed the automatic jump before throwing the fireball.
[/list]

And fixes:
[list]
[*] Corrected the activation conditions for desperation attacks (now triggers below 10% HP).
[*] Resolved a softlock issue in "How to Play" mode.
[*] Fixed minor issues with input bindings.
[*] Addressed incorrect display of UI action hints.
[*] Various other minor bug fixes and adjustments.
[/list]

Thank you for your ongoing feedback!

notes.title: New version 1.0.4 for Night Slashers: Remake is now live!
notes.notes:
New version 1.0.4 for Night Slashers: Remake is now live on all platforms!

New Features:
[list]
[*] Added new death animations for the Executioner enemy type
[*] Binding option for simultaneous press of Attack and Jump buttons
[*] Intro sequence now replays after staying idle on the title screen
[*] Option to disable the grain filter in the options menu
[/list]

Adjustments:
[list]
[*] Tweaked Mad Doc's attack patterns
[*] Improved wall-bounce mechanics for smoother gameplay
[*] Adjusted immunity frames on super attacks and grabs
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Resolved issue with charged attacks not always starting
[*] Fixed tutorial enemies not reliably falling to the ground
[*] Corrected a rare bug where Jake's first grab would misplace the enemy
[*] Additional minor bug fixes and adjustments.
[/list]

Thank you for your ongoing feedback and support!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 for Night Slashers: Remake is now live!
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.3 for Night Slashers: Remake is now live!

This latest update includes several fixes and adjustments. You can read the full patch notes here:

Updates:
[list]
[*] Added better dynamic lightning in Stage 3
[*] Added better VFX to Jake's Desperation Move and Jake's charged attack
[*] UI Update: Added visual information on HP bars for minimal HP needed to perform a Special Attack
[/list]
Adjustments:
[list]
[*] Added more food items on Stage 2
[*] Blocked possibility for too fast button press on game over menu
[*] Adjusted Golem behavior: No insta grab from knockdown anymore
[*] Adjusted Golem behavior: Characters will not get stunned after hitting border after getting hit by Golem's strong punch
[*] Adjusted Golem behavior: No insta grab from knockdown anymore
[*] Added immunity frames for Chris' Desperation Move
[*] Adjusted attack colliders for Death Boss
[*] Adjusted height of Liu Feilin's thrown objects
[*] Adjusted Bat's attack position
[*] Adjusted Liu Feilin's air Special Attack timing
[*] Adjusted timing of charged attack activation on button release
[*] Adjusted timings of spawn on Stage 1 to better show spawn animations
[*] Adjusted and added immunity frames on grab attacks for all playable characters
[*] Adjusted and added immunity frames on Desperation Moves for all playable characters
[*] Adjusted King Zarutz's Demon Head position on spawn animation
[*] Adjusted timings of King Zarutz's fireballs in chase section of Stage 7
[*] Adjusted timing of active hit collider of Haunted Paintings on Stage 3
[*] Adjusted slightly movement speed of all playable characters
[*] Adjusted slightly movement speed of some enemies and bosses
[/list]
 
Fixes:
[list]
[*] After picking up food item, HP will be restored instantly, not after finished combo
[*] Fixed problem with bonus level 2 gauge not filling up above 60 FPS
[*] Fixed problem with enemies hanging in air on Stage 3 elevator fight
[*] Fixed problem with flipped player indicators in Secret Section
[*] Fixed problem with characters getting stuck in a plane on start of Stage 6
[*] Fixed problem with charged attack sometimes not working after getting grabbed by a boss
[*] Fixed problem with thrown items not always registering collision when enemy is near stage border
[/list]

[list]
[*] Other minor fixes and improvements
[/list]

Thank you for your ongoing feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Thank you for your ongoing feedback!

Patch 1.0.2 Release Notes:

New Features:
- Enabled 'Remote Play' option on Steam

Fixes:
- Fixed problem with missing animation frames on some boss characters
- Fixed problems with glitching AI on some bosses
- Fixed problem with Chris Desperation Move not connecting all attacks correctly

Adjustments:
- Added invulnerability frames for Liu Feilin's forward grab attack
- Shortened time of hit collider on Liu Feilin's down jump grab attack
- Improved color selection for characters when joining during game
- Adjusted spawn positions for characters in secret area when playing on more than 2 players
